question: The plan between fifth five year plan and sixth five year plan is known as ______.
solution: The correct answer is __**Roiling**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Rolling Plan in India was started in 1978__. • The rolling plan concept was coined by **Gunnar Myrdal.** • This plan was rejected again by the Indian National Congress government when it came to power in 1980 and a new sixth plan was made. • The main advantage of the rolling plans is that they are flexible. • **The Rolling Plan **is a plan in which every year the performance of the plan is assessed and a new plan is made next year based on this assessment. • Thus, both the allocation and targets are revised during this plan.
